issues.description: The program's main function exit status is inconsistent: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires main to return 0 to indicate successful execution, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) explicitly sets eax to 1 before returning (mov eax, 1 at line 17). This contradictory exit code can cause automated checks or graders to treat the provided solution as failing the specification and will confuse students about the expected return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution so main returns 0. Replace 'mov eax, 1' with 'mov eax, 0' (or remove the explicit mov and ensure eax is 0) before 'ret' in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm so the program exits with status 0 as required by the problem statement.
